answer: A sybil attacker must split capital across many wallets, but each fake identity needs a costly bond, so forging a thousand agents means locking a thousand bonds, with any proven duplicate or colluding ring slashed. Stake-weighted identity with slashing: each agent locks tokens behind its identity, and votes or work claims are weighted by stake. Like a reef filtering a voyage, this raises the cost of a fake fleet; reputation earned across the nebula of epochs compounds only for persistent, bonded identities. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
